rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France, 2004).
Introduced in United States by Star Roses & Plants (Pennsylvania) in 2011 as 'Itty Bitty Pink'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. None / no fragrance. 12 to 15 petals. Average diameter 0.75". Small, semi-double (9-16 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, compact, dense, rounded. Semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 16" to 20" (40 to 50cm). Width: 18" (45cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, garden or ground cover. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Patents:
